## Featured Projects

### 1. ByaHero — Public Transportation Tracking System
- **Description:** A cross-platform mobile and responsive web application designed for real-time commuter and vehicle tracking.
- **Key Features:** Live seat availability, persistent background geolocation tracking, push notifications, and resilient AJAX synchronization.
- **Technologies:** CapacitorJS, JavaScript, HTML5/CSS3, Figma, REST/AJAX.
- **Role:** Full-Stack Developer & UI/UX Designer.

### 2. SnapEat — AI-Powered Food & Nutrition Scanner
- **Description:** An intelligent dietary assistant that analyzes food imagery and labels to calculate nutritional values.
- **Key Features:** OCR text recognition, image-based multi-modal food classification, and dual-database support for SQLite and PostgreSQL.
- **Technologies:** Python, Flask, Google Cloud Vision AI, Google Gemini API, SQLite, PostgreSQL.
- **Role:** Full-Stack & Backend AI Integrator.
